title: Vallee's own UFO sighting at age 15

tellings.quote: after I saw when I was 15 I saw that object outside the room over the the yard

plain: In the 1950s, in France, a 15-year-old boy saw a strange object outside his room, above the yard. The boy was Jacques Vallée, who later became a well-known UFO researcher, and he tells it as his own sighting. He describes it simply as "that object outside the room over the yard," a sighting that came before his long study of the subject.
